LangGraph — Build Stateful Multi-Agent Applications

LangGraph is a library for building stateful, multi-actor applications with LLMs. It extends LangChain with graph-based orchestration, enabling cyclical workflows, human-in-the-loop patterns, and persistent state across long-running agent tasks.
